verdict.rationale: Kong documents a Konnect AI Gateway management API (e.g. list-ai-gateways). It also documents kongctl, which supports both declarative resources-as-code and imperative commands, so much of the configuration can clearly be driven programmatically. However, nothing in the evidence states that the API matches what the UI can do, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that analytics and dashboard functions are exposed via the API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
